scope: The L1 semantic admission condition ONLY. L2 similarity threshold, L2 temporal eligibility, L2 re-registration, all L3 logic, half-lives, risk budgets, timestamps, cache-update semantics, request order and the freshness-class source are unchanged and are asserted unchanged by a file-hash check before and after every run.

answer_type.as_implemented: reject only when BOTH answer types are detectable and differ (the recorded rule)
answer_type.required: both answer types must be detectable AND equal

structural_guards.on: recorded gate AND the three deterministic guards in l1_structural_guards.py (numeric/date, negation, comparative/superlative)

guards_contain_no_model: pure string operations; no LLM, no embedding, no network, no randomness, in the online L1 path
replay: TRUE SEQUENTIAL replay of the full validation stream for every cell. Changing an L1 decision changes later cache state, so no cell is produced by filtering another cell's L1 hits.
data: VALIDATION clusters only. Held-out test results are not computed, inspected or used at any point during selection.

wai_measurability.finding: No validation-side answer audit exists before this study: every earlier audit (the general held-out audit, the stronger-generator audit and the mixed-age audit) samples TEST clusters only; none of their requests falls in a validation cluster.
wai_measurability.consequence: Validation WAI is not available for all 96 cells, and generating 96 validation audits is not feasible. Selection is therefore TWO-STAGE, declared here before any cell is run.

stage_1.description: Run all grid cells on validation. Keep the cells that satisfy the hard constraints, rank by the primary objective, and carry the top K forward.
hard_constraints: C1: validation search_saved_pct >= (recorded FreshCache validation search_saved_pct - 0.10 percentage points)
C3: at least 100 validation L1 hits
stage_1.primary_objective: MINIMISE validation L1 semantic mismatch under the ties->DIFFERENT convention

stage_2.description: Build ONE new policy-neutral 400-request answer audit sampled from VALIDATION clusters (same 28-stratum design, same seed 42, same evidence builder and context limits as the recorded audit), and measure WAI for the recorded gate and for each of the K carried-forward cells. Then apply C2 and the tie-breaks.
stage_2.hard_constraint: C2: validation WAI must not exceed the recorded FreshCache validation WAI. If WAI is not measurable for a cell, C2 is recorded as NOT_EVALUABLE for that cell and the cell is NOT eliminated by it.

selection.explicitly_not_an_objective: L1 hit rate is NOT maximised. Semantic precision is the objective and hit count enters only as constraint C3 and tie-break 3.

equivalence_jury.prompt: identical to the paper's equivalence prompt (scripts/experiments/ablations/l1_precision_gate/l1_hit_generation_judging_protocol.py)
equivalence_jury.blinding: the judge sees the two query strings only, never the policy or arm
equivalence_jury.tie_rule: a 2-2 split is a TIE and is reported as its own category; all three conventions (ties->DIFFERENT, ties excluded, ties->SAME) are reported and none is hidden

answer_audit.held_out_sample: the SAME 400-request held-out audit (outputs/general_audit/sample.json), request IDs asserted identical
answer_audit.freshness_class_source: COLLECTION CLASS -- the class carried by tiered_cache_model.build_query_records, which is what the manuscript headline held-out FreshCache arm uses. The predicted-class arm is NOT used for the primary comparison.
answer_audit.labelling_rule: the manuscript rule, verbatim from scripts/evaluation/answer_audits/general_audit_analysis.py: an answer matching the abstention pattern is ABSTAIN; otherwise CORRECT only if BOTH judges (Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B) say CORRECT, else WRONG. Judge disagreement therefore collapses to WRONG, exactly as in the manuscript.
answer_audit.secondary_rule: the three-way rule that separates JUDGE_DISAGREEMENT is reported alongside, clearly labelled, and is never substituted for the primary.
answer_audit.reproduction_gate: the recorded gate must reproduce the recorded held-out WAI under the primary rule before any comparison is believed.

FULLY_RESOLVED_requires_all: overall FreshCache search savings fall by <= 0.10 percentage points
held-out WAI does not increase materially
the result holds on the ENTIRE realised L1 population, not only shared hits
success_criteria.STRONGLY_ADDRESSED: mismatch substantially below the held-out mismatch of the stricter 0.90 similarity floor but above 10%
success_criteria.no_threshold_manipulation: the grid and the selection rule are fixed here; neither will be altered to reach the 10% criterion.

optional_second_stage_verifier.trigger: ONLY if the best deterministic validation-selected cell still has poor VALIDATION mismatch (declared here as > 15% under ties->DIFFERENT on validation).
optional_second_stage_verifier.constraint: no LLM; inspect locally available cross-encoder / reranker models first; a new model download must be reported explicitly. Any pairwise threshold is tuned on validation only.

instantiation: l1_precision_protocol.py writes the instantiated pre-registration (this protocol plus the fixed recorded reference values, the write time and the SHA-256 of l1_structural_guards.py) to outputs/l1_precision/l1_precision_prereg.json before any grid cell is evaluated
